The '''King''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yarrv]] was the head of an interconnected set of royal families. He was targeted for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Karin]] of [[Darpheos]]
